pageTitle: Heathrow Airport Hotels | Book Cheap Hotels Near Heathrow Airport | Premier.
pageDescription: Our Premier Inn London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel is ideal for stays close to Heathrow and airport parking.
hotelDescription:
Our London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel makes getting to Heathrow Airport stress-free. We’re also really easy to get to ourselves, just off junction 4 of the M4 and close to train stations, Heathrow Express and Heathrow Connect trains. Our hotel has short term on-site parking and deals for longer term airport parking through our partners at Holiday Extras. Wake up to a delicious breakfast at our on-site Thyme restaurant, before enjoying a relaxing sleep on one of the super-comfy kingsize beds in one of 134 spacious rooms at our hotel.    

There’s plenty to do in the area if you have time before your flight. We’re only a short drive from Twickenham High Street, Twickenham Stadium and Harmondsworth Moor. We’re also close to high street shops and supermarkets in nearby Hayes Town Centre and Drayton Garden Village. If you’re sightseeing or planning a day out, we’re only a 20-minute drive from Thorpe Park and we have good links to major attractions in London like the South Bank, Royal Festival Hall and Oxford Street shops, and from London great links to Brighton and the coast.    

Find everything you need to know about Heathrow Airport in our Heathrow Airport guide and, if you’re flying from another airport soon, keep our other Premier Inn airport hotels in mind to make your flight as easy and stress-free as possible.
hotelDirections: From M4 exit Jtn 4 then follow signs to Uxbridge remaining in left hand lane. Bear left following signs for other routes and Hayes. At give way point, use as a roundabout and take the 4th exit off (sign posted Hayes). The hotel is 200 yards away on the right hand side. (SAT NAV - UB3 1RW) Parking costs 7 GBP per night for Premier Inn guests.
parkingDescription:
Our London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel has 121 on-site parking spaces in total, chargeable at £7 for 24 hours. Parking availability can vary, if you have any questions please contact the hotel prior to your stay.

Airport parking is available through our partners Holiday Extras at great prices (see frequently asked questions section for more details).

faqItems.question: Can you walk from Heathrow airport to Premier Inn London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Yes but it’s not advisable. It’s about a 40-minute walk to the entrance of the tunnel road that leads to Heathrow Terminals 2 & 3, there are regular buses which follow this road straight to the Heathrow Airport terminals. The walk through the tunnel road brings the walking time to an hour or so and the path is not always accommodating.

faqItems.question: How do I get from Heathrow Terminal 4 to your Premier Inn London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: The quickest route is to take the bus or other connections to Terminals 2 & 3 and then take the Piccadilly Line to Hatton Cross station, from Hatton Cross there are buses such as the 482, 490 or 222 that travel directly to Terminal 4.

faqItems.question: Does your Premier Inn London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel have parking?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer:
Yes, our London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel has 121 on-site parking spaces in total, chargeable at £7 for 24 hours.    

Airport parking is available through our partners Holiday Extras at great prices.

faqItems.question: How do I add airport parking to my booking?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Click here to take you to our partners at Holiday Extras, where you can add your airport parking details. Holiday Extras packages include meet and greet, park and ride and on-site airport parking. Prices and terms are all explained on the Holiday Extras page.

faqItems.question: Can I book airport lounges, fast passes and other extras?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Click here to take you to our partners at Holiday Extras, where you can book airport lounges, fast track passes and other extras to make your flight even easier.

faqItems.question: What time is breakfast at your Premier Inn London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Most restaurants at our airport hotels serve breakfast from 6:30am-10:00am, but times can vary. Breakfast is often served later at weekends, and times can change during school and bank holidays. Please contact the hotel in advance for specific breakfast times during your stay.

faqItems.question: Which room amenities are available at your Premier Inn London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Our rooms include double or kingsize Hypnos beds, a selection of pillows, a desk, chair, tea and coffee making facilities, free Wi-Fi, a Freeview TV and bathrooms with power showers.

faqItems.question: Is your Premier Inn London Heathrow Airport (M4/J4) hotel accessible?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Our hotels have level access entry or ramps where level access is not possible. Our accessible rooms have more space for wheelchairs and lowered beds (which can be adjusted on request before arrival). Our accessible bathrooms have wider entry, with wet rooms or lowered baths depending on availability. If you have any questions or requests, please contact the hotel before you arrive.

faqItems.question: Why book with Premier Inn?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: With our flexible booking rates, great-value hotels and luxurious Hypnos beds in every room, you can look forward to fun, family-friendly stays when booking with Premier Inn. Plus, you can sleep easy thanks to our Premier Inn CleanProtect promise - we ensure all rooms and communal spaces have been rigorously cleaned for the safety of our guests and team members.

faqItems.question: Why is booking with Premier Inn the right choice for families?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Our Premier Inn rooms offer all the comfort and value you need for fun family breaks. All our hotels are child-friendly, and our restaurants have delicious and nutritious meals for kids, too. And don't forget, when an adult orders a full Premier Inn Breakfast or Meal Deal, up to two kids eat breakfast free.

faqItems.question: Why is booking with Premier Inn the right choice for business travellers?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: From booking to check out, our Premier Inn hotels are ideal for business trips. Just some of the perks for business guests include access to exclusive flexible rates through our free online booking tool, free cancellations if your plans change, speedy check-in and check-out, rigorously cleaned hotel rooms as part of our Premier Inn CleanProtect promise, free Wi-Fi, and – of course – our famous Premier Inn Breakfast.
